facts.text: Audrey makes jewelry from recycled objects such as bottle caps, buttons, and broken jewelry.

evidence.quote: I love making jewelry out of recycled stuff. It's a great way to show my love of creativity and sustainability. I hunt down things like bottle caps, buttons, and broken jewelry, and then turn them into one-of-a-kind pieces.

facts.text: Audrey sells her jewelry and donates a portion of the profits to a cause that is close to her heart.

evidence.quote: I started making jewelry as a hobby and then started selling it. I donate a portion of my profits to a cause that's close to my heart.

facts.text: Audrey's jewelry pieces hold special stories and have their own appeal.

evidence.quote: They all hold a special story and have their own appeal.
